LanguageData.RR_CannotBearRazor: {PAWN_nameDef} is not of Gold, and {PAWN_possessive} ideoligion forbids any lesser Color to bear a razor.
LanguageData.RR_CannotWearCasteArmor: {PAWN_nameDef} holds no title and is not of Gold, and {PAWN_possessive} ideoligion reserves recoil plate for those the hierarchy has decided to trust.
LanguageData.RR_CannotHoldServiceTitle: {PAWN_nameDef} is of Gold. The service ladder is what the Society offers those it will never raise, and {TITLE} is not a rank a Gold may hold.
LanguageData.RR_CannotConceiveAcrossColors: {PAWN1_nameDef} and {PAWN2_nameDef} are different Colors. The castes were engineered too far apart to interbreed; only a Carver could bridge it.
LanguageData.RR_Setting_SuppressXenotypesTip: Stops hussars, genies, neanderthals, impids, wasters, yttakin, pigskins, dirtmoles and highmates being generated, in factions and among wanderers alike, so new pawns read as Colors or as baseliners. The xenotypes themselves are untouched: existing pawns keep theirs, and they can still be built in a gene assembler.
LanguageData.RR_Setting_SuppressFactionsTip: Removes the generic outlander, tribal and pirate factions from the default world, leaving the planet to the Society and its rivals. Hidden factions, the ancients and the Empire are left alone. Nothing is deleted, so you can still add any of them back by hand on the world creation page.
LanguageData.RR_Setting_SuppressNote: These affect world generation only. Changing them will not alter a world that already exists - start a new one to see the difference.
LanguageData.RR_CannotHoldGoldTitle: {PAWN_nameDef} is not of Gold. The standing of {TITLE} is conferred by the Institute, and the Institute does not admit lesser Colors.
LanguageData.RR_Setting_AllowCarvingTip: Adds surgeries that rebuild a person into another Color directly, at great expense. Turn this off to keep carving as it is in vanilla Biotech - assembling a xenogerm at a gene assembler, which for a Gold means twenty-two gene processors and archite genes bought from traders. Switching this off removes a shortcut, not a capability.
LanguageData.RR_CarvingComplete: {PAWN_nameDef} has been carved. The registries will record {PAWN_objective} as {COLOR}.
LanguageData.RR_GravLaunchDesc: Ride the boots' field up out of the map and set down somewhere else on the planet, up to {0} tiles away. Anyone launching alone arrives alone, and arrives as a caravan on open ground rather than inside a settlement.
LanguageData.RR_GravLaunchCooldown: The boots are still bleeding off charge: {0} remaining.
LanguageData.RR_GravFlightArrived: The grav flight has come down.
LanguageData.RR_StatTraumaSuiteDesc:
The suit injects a stimulant on its own when the wearer starts bleeding badly or is in serious pain, and will not dose again until the last one wears off. It synthesises a replacement dose every {0}.
The suit also seals wounds continuously while worn, which is a separate effect and does not run out.
